title: What does a practiced chunk save?
hook: Two toy routines pay a setup cost before each completed block of work.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to explain setup amortization without equating a toy block with a measured cognitive chunk

misconception: Chunking must expand a fixed human memory capacity by the same factor as grouped toy work.
objective: Explain setup amortization without equating a toy block with a measured cognitive chunk.
